headline_marked: [[Islami Chhatra Shibir leader killed]] in Gaibandha over school committee dispute
headline: Islami Chhatra Shibir leader killed in Gaibandha over school committee dispute
summary: The victim, Saifulullah Bari, was allegedly attacked by BNP and Juba Dal activists. Shibir has called for the immediate arrest of the perpetrators.
details: Saifulullah Bari, the president of the Bonarpara Union Islami Chhatra Shibir, was killed in an attack in Gaibandha's Saghata Upazila on Sunday afternoon.
The incident occurred at the Bonarpara Chaurasta intersection following a dispute over the management committee of a primary school.
According to reports, the attack was carried out by activists from the BNP and Juba Dal.
In response, the Dhaka metropolitan branch of Chhatra Shibir organized a protest march from the Central Shaheed Minar to Shahbag in Dhaka on Sunday night.
During a rally at Shahbag, Shibir central president Nurul Islam Saddam condemned the attack as 'barbaric' and 'cowardly,' stating it is not part of a healthy political culture.
Saddam warned that if the 'politics of killing' continues, the people would drive the BNP out of the country, similar to what happened with the Awami League.
Central office secretary Azizur Rahman also criticized the BNP, alleging that they have occupied various institutions, including colleges, universities, and banks, across the country.
Shibir leaders have demanded that the killers be arrested immediately and given exemplary punishment under the law.
caption:
A Chhatra Shibir leader was killed in Gaibandha over a school committee dispute. Now, Shibir warns the BNP: stop the 'politics of killing' or face the people's wrath.

Saifulullah Bari, the president of the Bonarpara Union Islami Chhatra Shibir, was killed in an attack in Gaibandha's Saghata Upazila on Sunday afternoon.

The incident occurred at the Bonarpara Chaurasta intersection following a dispute over the management committee of a primary school.

According to reports, the attack was carried out by activists from the BNP and Juba Dal.

In response, the Dhaka metropolitan branch of Chhatra Shibir organized a protest march from the Central Shaheed Minar to Shahbag in Dhaka on Sunday night.

During a rally at Shahbag, Shibir central president Nurul Islam Saddam condemned the attack as 'barbaric' and 'cowardly,' stating it is not part of a healthy political culture.

Saddam warned that if the 'politics of killing' continues, the people would drive the BNP out of the country, similar to what happened with the Awami League.

Central office secretary Azizur Rahman also criticized the BNP, alleging that they have occupied various institutions, including colleges, universities, and banks, across the country.

Shibir leaders have demanded that the killers be arrested immediately and given exemplary punishment under the law.

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV

headline: Man killed by elder brother while praying in mosque
summary: A youth was hacked to death by his own elder brother during prayers at a mosque.
details: A youth was hacked to death by his elder brother while he was praying in a mosque.
The incident occurred during prayer time, turning a place of worship into a scene of crime.
The elder brother allegedly attacked the victim with a sharp weapon, leading to his death.
Local authorities have been notified of the incident and are investigating the cause behind the attack.
